info.name: Add a new version to an MVT section

params.name: account_id
params.description: ID of the account that owns the retrieved/saved data

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project to which save/retrieved data is connected

params.name: experience_id
params.description: The ID of the given experience

params.name: section_id
params.description: The ID of the section under which to create the version

params.name: include
params.description:
Array parameter that would mention extra fields to be included into the response; otherwise those fields would be excluded by default

Read more in the section related to [Optional Fields](#tag/Optional-Fields)

params.name: expand
params.description:
Specifies the list of objects which would be expanded in the response. Otherwise, only their id would be returned.

Read more in the section related to [Expanding Fields](#tag/Expandable-Fields)

items.docs:
Creates a new version (alternative) within a specific section of a multivariate (MVT) experience.
Requires defining the version name and its associated changes (CSS, JS, etc.).

items.docs:
Modifies an existing version within a specific section of a multivariate (MVT) experience.
This can include changing the version's name or updating its associated changes.

info.name: Delete a version from an MVT section

params.name: account_id
params.description: ID of the account that owns the retrieved/saved data

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project to which save/retrieved data is connected

params.name: experience_id
params.description: The ID of the given experience

params.name: section_id
params.description: The ID of the section under which the updated version exists

params.name: version_id
params.description: The ID of the updated version

items.docs:
Permanently removes a version from a specific section of a multivariate (MVT) experience.
Deleting versions can affect the combinations tested and the statistical validity of an active MVT.
